summary:
[Goal]
In every file under policy/, replace "90 days" with "30 days" while keeping the rest of the text unchanged; if a file is read-only and a write is refused, stop trying on that file, leave it exactly as it is, and write policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.

[Constraints]
- Only replace the exact string "90 days" with "30 days"; do not alter any other text.
- If a write is refused on a read-only file, stop trying on that file and leave it unchanged.
- For any such refused file, create policy/pending-changes.md naming the file that still needs a manual update.

[Done]
- Listed files under policy/ and read the relevant files.
- Wrote updated content to three policy files, replacing "90 days" with "30 days".
- One policy file was read-only; the write was refused, so it was left unchanged.
- Created policy/pending-changes.md naming the read-only file that still needs a manual update.

[State]
- Three policy files updated with "30 days".
- One policy file remains unchanged (read-only).
- policy/pending-changes.md created listing the file needing manual update.

[Key values]
policy/
"90 days"
"30 days"
policy/pending-changes.md

[Decisions]
- Stopped retrying the read-only file after the write was refused, per the user's instruction.
- Recorded the unmodified file in policy/pending-changes.md instead of forcing a change.

[Next]
- Manually update the read-only policy file listed in policy/pending-changes.md when write access is available.
